accepted_evidence.finding: 120 frozen entry/breadth/primitive-exit cells over the shared 1,066 dev days; every reported surface-wide basket-day mean is negative at 100 and 150 bps.
accepted_evidence.interpretation: baseline constraint; does not reject untested conditional actions

accepted_evidence.finding: At-least-two +30% post-fill MFE touch rates span 0.68%-12.67% in block1 and 1.51%-22.59% in block2 across all cells; all-filled EOD-positive rates span 0.27%-15.94% and 0%-14.16%, respectively.
accepted_evidence.interpretation: joint opportunity and EOD distribution only; EOD-positive open_end tickets are marked, not realized exits

accepted_evidence.finding: At ET 600, mean remaining MFE and +50/+100 touch probability are higher in block2 than block1 for all five entry families. B600 mean remaining MFE is 11.80% vs 15.29%; +50 touch is 3.70% vs 5.40%; +100 touch is 0.97% vs 1.64%.
accepted_evidence.interpretation: checkpoint-close-relative future outcomes; no executable return, action effect, gate, or selected feature bucket

accepted_evidence.finding: All computed equal, rank-linear and mild score-gap mean outcomes are negative in both blocks; changes versus equal are sparse and average changes are negative.
accepted_evidence.interpretation: initial fixed-path reweighting does not establish sizing alpha; later checkpoint multipliers remain non-computable

accepted_evidence.finding: All 1,066 daily environment rows use fixed labels, anatomy and bars with et < 600 and map all 120 F1 cells across both blocks.
accepted_evidence.interpretation: 10:00 A-family outcome associations are retrospective for pre-10 entries; selected-name trend is not broad-market regime

rejected_or_limited_evidence.reason: MFE is a post-fill path maximum; no action executes at the maximum. open_end ticket net is an EOD mark, not a realized exit.

ranked_next_registered_tests.candidate_action: Release deteriorating exposure using entry-relative/peak-relative structure, then only frozen R2 or R3 modules.
ranked_next_registered_tests.evidence_warrant: negative primitive F1 economics coexist with joint member tail touches and measurable checkpoint remaining outcomes in both blocks; directly tests whether reducing failed-ticket cost sacrifices survivors.
ranked_next_registered_tests.test_definition: Map depth, duration, recovery/reclaim, MFE surrendered and time since peak without outcome-fitted thresholds; then register R2 L={10,15}, grace w={3,5,10} and/or R3 g={40,50,60} under the frozen event timing and execution contract.
ranked_next_registered_tests.causal_timing: state only from completed bars through declared decision; exit at first eligible later bar open; outcome after execution; no same-bar lookahead.
ranked_next_registered_tests.falsifier: No net C0 EV / failed-ticket-loss improvement in both blocks at 100 bps without materially reducing raw-MFE>=50/100 captured contribution; 150 bps is adversity.

ranked_next_registered_tests.candidate_action: Add capital only on a declared own-state strengthening event (new-high continuation, recovery-after-breach, or separately frozen simple golden gate).
ranked_next_registered_tests.evidence_warrant: F2/F12 ET-600 remaining-tail means and +50/+100 touch rates are higher in block2 for all five entry families; this motivates an incremental-capital test, not a gate claim.
ranked_next_registered_tests.test_definition: Pre-register a single event/eligibility rule and checkpoint; compare permitted +25/+50/+100% original unit notional adds, total adds <= +100%; report incremental tranche net EV and remaining tail at add time.
ranked_next_registered_tests.causal_timing: no pre-10 A entry condition may use 10:00; add decision uses only completed bars; execute next eligible bar open; measure subsequent outcome only.
ranked_next_registered_tests.falsifier: Incremental net EV is non-positive after friction, positive in only one block, or add funding violates cash / gross<=C0 constraints.
depends_on: F2/F12 state panel; no current gate declared

ranked_next_registered_tests.candidate_action: Scale out a deteriorating member or de-risk the basket only after F3 establishes a registered deterioration event worth testing.
ranked_next_registered_tests.evidence_warrant: joint basket EOD failures coexist with members reaching meaningful raw MFE; a finite tranche test can quantify the opportunity cost of releasing risk earlier.
ranked_next_registered_tests.test_definition: Use only F3/golden deterioration modules; frozen tranche sizes 25/33/50% and patterns 25->25->rest, 33->33->rest, 50->rest; compare per-ticket and declared basket mode K={2,3}, x={25%,50%}.
ranked_next_registered_tests.causal_timing: trigger from completed bars; execute next eligible open; attribute EV to each tranche and track tail retained/false releases.
ranked_next_registered_tests.falsifier: No dual-block net basket EV improvement after friction without worse tail-retention/captured-net tradeoff than full release.
depends_on: F3 structural map and registered module

ranked_next_registered_tests.candidate_action: Hold a fixed C0 reserve and deploy once to equal surviving members at checkpoint 585 or 600, with cash as control.
ranked_next_registered_tests.evidence_warrant: F2/F12 confirms remaining outcome exists at the golden checkpoints across blocks, while F1 shows full equal deployment loses net; reserve can test whether delaying exposure improves incremental capital EV.
ranked_next_registered_tests.test_definition: Register p={0.67,0.5,0.33}, one permitted deployment checkpoint, equal-across-survivor rule and cash control; no gate-survivor allocation until a gate is independently declared.
ranked_next_registered_tests.causal_timing: reserve amount fixed at entry; deploy only from state known by chosen checkpoint and fill at next eligible open; record undeployed cash and missed tail.
ranked_next_registered_tests.falsifier: Reserve tranche incremental net C0 EV is non-positive after friction or positive in one block only.

ranked_next_registered_tests.candidate_action: Recycle released capital equally among eligible surviving members, versus retaining released cash.
ranked_next_registered_tests.evidence_warrant: F1 R1 release paths create a testable capital-release event, but no current artifact shows that released funds have positive later-use EV.
ranked_next_registered_tests.test_definition: After a registered F3/F4 release, compare recycle fractions {0,50%,100%} using equal survivor allocation and cash control; prohibit leverage and golden-gate allocation until a gate exists.
ranked_next_registered_tests.causal_timing: only after actual executed release and at a later eligible action event; fills at next eligible open; incremental recycled-tranche net return separated from prior realized P&L.
ranked_next_registered_tests.falsifier: Recycled incremental net C0 EV is non-positive in either block or cash/gross<=C0 constraints fail.
depends_on: F3/F4 registered release path; demonstrated later eligible event
